en.title: Boiled Spinach with Oil and Lemon

steps.n1: After washing thoroughly and picking the leaves, boil in a little boiling water with salt until tender.
steps.n2: After boiling, chop the spinach coarsely.
steps.n3: In a bowl, combine the oil, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and minced garlic; stir the mixture well to thicken it, then toss the spinach thoroughly in the dressing.

legacySteps: After washing thoroughly and picking the leaves, boil in a little boiling water with salt until tender.
After boiling, chop the spinach coarsely.
In a bowl, combine the oil, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and minced garlic; stir the mixture well to thicken it, then toss the spinach thoroughly in the dressing.
